findings.title: D-R20-05 leaves two plated terminal holes 0.25 mm from foreign inner copper, under JLC's 0.3 mm inner-layer PTH-pad hole-to-copper minimum

evidence.method: native pcbnew: every PAD_ATTRIB_PTH pad, each inner layer, distance from the finished-hole wall to the nearest different-net zone fill / track / via (probe pth_inner.py). Every other plated pad on the board measures >= 0.55 mm (it keeps a 1.9 mm inner ring 0.25 mm from foreign copper). The fab Gerbers confirm no In1 flash at J400.2 and no In2 flash at J1.2 / J400.2 / J121.1.
evidence.rule_in_project: m3.kicad_dru 'General copper to hole clearance' min 0.25 mm, so DRC passes at exactly 0.250
evidence.maker_rule: JLCPCB PCB capabilities, https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities (read 2026-10-31): 'Inner layer via hole to copper clearance' 0.2 mm; 'Inner layer PTH pad hole to copper clearance' 0.3 mm; plated hole tolerance +0.13 / -0.08 mm
evidence.history: Before D-R20-05 both pads had inner rings, so wall-to-copper was 0.55 mm; the record (D-R20-05 'Side effect at J1.2') equates 0.25 mm with the via hole clearance, but JLC's via rule (0.2) does not apply to a component PTH pad (0.3).

findings.impact: A fab-capability breach at two plated holes, first created by the round 20 polish. JLC's DFM may query or silently pull back the copper; at worst a drill wander or the +0.13 mm hole tolerance (wall moves 0.065 mm) leaves about 0.185 mm to a pour on a 1.3 mm drilled hole. A GND-to-RAW_PROTECTED short at J1.2 leaves U9 current-limiting and the board not running; a BAT_SW_RETURN-to-GND short at J400.2 holds EN low and the board off (fail-safe, but the switch would be dead). No inadvertent-fire path.
findings.concrete_fix: Add a .kicad_dru rule for plated pad holes, e.g. (rule "JLC inner PTH pad hole to copper" (condition "A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole'") (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.3mm))), refill zones (In1 GND at J400.2 and In2 RAW_PROTECTED at J1.2 each back off 0.05 mm), and have the gate assert >= 0.30 mm for component PTH pads. Alternatively give J1 its own 2P_GN footprint that keeps pad 2's rings. Check the RAW_PROTECTED neck near J1.2 after the refill (K-plane).

evidence.docs: docs/ORDERING.md line 423 still says 'U4 is the stocked ISM6HG256XTR (C51931514); use consigned LSM6DSV320XTR only if that stock is gone', whereas line 280 says it is short (2 orderable for 5).

findings.impact: Five boards cannot be assembled from JLC stock today. The documented fallback (consign the LSM6DSV320X) requires a CPL rotation change (0 deg from its own EasyEDA footprint), a re-verified CPL and the other register map; a mixed 2 + 3 build would leave two firmware variants.
findings.concrete_fix: Prefer buying ISM6HG256XTR from a franchised source and consigning it (CPL 180 deg and the fitted firmware map unchanged); keep the LSM path as second fallback. Reword ORDERING line 423 to 'short at JLC (2 orderable for 5); consign'. Order-day cart check remains.
